page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening): one block of running text in one column, with the running head and page number at the top. Nothing in the margins. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "Per". The narrow strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: laceratur,2.Reg.2.v.23.Jeroboami manus, quam in virum Dei, ad apprehendendum ipsum, ex-tendit, ut ultimo ipsum supplicio afficeret, sa-tim exaruit, ut retrahere illam ad se non posset, 1.Reg.13.v.4.Achabus,rex Israëlis, Micham pro-phetam in domum carceris poni, & pane arcto cibari mandat, donec redeat ab expeditione contra Ramoth-Gilead. Verum in prælio lagit-tâ vulneratus moritur, & canes sanguinem ipsius lingunt, 1.Reg.22.v.27.38. Zacharias sacerdos, conjuratione contra ipsum facta, obruitur lapi-dibus in atrio domus Jehovæ, ex mandato Ama-siæ, regis Juda. Servi autem sui, propter sangui-nem filiorum Jojada sacerdotis, conjurant con-tra ipsum, & occidunt eum in lecto suo: Deo ni-mirum ad hanc ultionem servorum horum fa-cinore bene abutente, cùm illi, vel præmiorum spe, vel aliis de caussis hoc facerent, 2.Paral.24. vers.20.& seqq. Asa, rex Juda, Hanani videntem ponit in carcerem, quòd propter fedus cum Ben-hadado Syro initum, ipsum reprehenderat. Qua-re morbo pedum vel podagrâ, à Deo affligitur, 2.Par.16. vers.10. Usia, rex Juda, quòd sacrificare prohiberetur, contra sacerdotes Domini irasci-tur, & superbè facit, ut non obediat voci sacer-dotum Domini, uti verba legis divinæ habent; sed Deus ordinis sacerdotalis dignitatem asserit, lepra ipsum percutiens, 2.Paral.26.v.19. Elymas Paulo & Barnabæ resistit, verbum Domini Ser-gio Paulo, proconsuli in Papho, annunciant-bus, quapropter cæcitate percutitur, Act.13.v.7. &seqq.

page.notes: Catchword "Per" at the lower right, below the last line. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. Doubtful: "lagit-tâ" (line-end break, read as lagittâ); "annunciant-bus" printed as such, not corrected. "Achabus" is printed as such (Ahab). Ellipses and abbreviations are as printed.
